# The Steak House on the Verandah
> Kingston's premier fine dining steakhouse located on the historic 1881 Devon House Mansion verandah.

- **Name**: The Steak House on the Verandah
- **Location**: 26 Hope Road, Devon House, Kingston 10, Jamaica, W.I.
- **Phone**: (876) 616-8831 / (876) 926-6867
- **Reservations**: reservations@steakhouseja.com
- **Core Specialties**: 35-41 day in-house dry-aged steaks (KSS - Kingston Signature Steak, Tomahawk, Ribeye, Filet Mignon), Scotch bonnet roasted bone marrow, ackee & house-cured salmon, pumpkin shrimp bisque, tomato callaloo fettuccine with Caribbean lobster tail, flourless chocolate cake with Devon Stout ice cream.
- **Hours**: Tue-Thu: 11am-9:30pm; Fri-Sat: 11am-10pm; Sun: 11:30am-8pm; Mon: Closed (Private Bookings).
